prompt: Create a minimalist flat vector illustration portrait of a young woman with long slightly wavy dark brown-black hair with loose bangs, wearing thin black-rimmed round glasses and an oversized plain black sweatshirt. She is shown from the chest up, centered, facing forward with her head slightly tilted, eyes open and looking calmly at the viewer, with a soft closed-mouth smile. One hand is gently resting against her cheek near the glasses frame, elbow lowered out of frame. Use warm tan skin tones, clean vector shapes, subtle painterly gradients, crisp dark outlines, simplified facial features, delicate highlights in the hair, and soft shadow blocks on the clothing. Set the portrait against a simple solid dark warm brown background with no text, no props, no watermark, and no photorealistic texture. Square canvas, close-cropped social media avatar composition, polished editorial vector art style.

promptZh: 创作一张极简主义的扁平化矢量插画肖像，主角为 一位年轻女性，留着 微卷的深棕黑色长发，配有随意的刘海，佩戴着 细黑框圆眼镜，身穿一件超大号的 纯黑色卫衣。画面展示其胸部以上部位，居中构图，正脸朝向前方，头部略微倾斜，双眼睁开并平静地注视着观众，嘴角带着柔和的微笑。一只手轻轻托在靠近眼镜框的脸颊旁，手肘位于画面外。采用暖棕色肤色、简洁的矢量形状、细腻的绘画感渐变、清晰的深色轮廓线、简化的面部特征、发丝上的精致高光以及衣物上柔和的阴影块。肖像背景为简单的纯色 深暖棕色，无文字、无道具、无水印，且不含照片级真实纹理。方形画布，紧凑的社交媒体头像构图，精致的编辑级矢量艺术风格。
